title: The loop reports once a day what Graphyard left running and the disk it holds
description: Run loop cycles across a UTC midnight with sweeps that stop orphaned processes and trial containers, reclaim disk, close a pane and remove a worktree. The first persist of the new day turns the previous day's counts and the disk readings into one report, logged once; master status shows it under leftovers, and taking the readings removes nothing.

steps.name: Report the day's leftovers and show them in master status
